name: zclass_world_add_sound
description: zClass_World::AddSound appends a sound node/data pair to a world and records the reverse attached-world link.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this world/sound list helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass world source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x451590 validates realloc-backed append of the sound node/data arrays, world sound-count increment, reverse attached-world append, and zero return.

The native smoke verifies AddSound appends the sound node and sound data to world storage, updates the world sound count, adds the world to the sound's attached-world list, and pairs with RemoveSound cleanup.
